name: What features should I prioritize in a rental bathroom remodel to attract tenants?

mainEntity.name: What features should I prioritize in a rental bathroom remodel to attract tenants?

acceptedAnswer.text: When remodeling a rental bathroom, prioritize features that offer broad appeal, durability, and easy maintenance. A clean, modern aesthetic with neutral colors is generally preferred. Focus on a functional layout, good lighting (both ambient and task), and ample storage. Key upgrades include water-efficient toilets and showerheads, updated vanity with a solid surface countertop, and durable, attractive flooring. A fresh coat of paint and new fixtures can also make a significant impact.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prioritize a clean, modern aesthetic with neutral colors, good lighting, and ample storage. Water-efficient fixtures, updated vanity, and durable flooring attract tenants.
